blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾 vs 滅菌（Sterilizing Filtration vs. Sterilization by Destruction）：
blocks.en: Sterilizing Filtration vs. Sterilization by Destruction:

blocks.zh: 破壞型（Destruction） — 高壓蒸汽滅菌（Autoclaving）、乾熱、輻射等方法殺死微生物
blocks.en: Destruction - methods such as autoclaving (steam sterilization), dry heat, and irradiation kill the microorganisms

blocks.zh: 去除型（Physical Removal） — 除菌過濾透過濾膜將微生物截留，不殺死它們
blocks.en: Physical Removal - sterilizing filtration retains microorganisms on the filter membrane without killing them

blocks.zh: 對生物製劑（biologics）而言，蛋白質藥物無法承受高溫滅菌，因此除菌過濾是唯一可行的最終滅菌方式 — 這就是為什麼它被稱為 "THE method for aseptic fill-finish of biologics"。
blocks.en: For biologics, protein drugs cannot withstand heat sterilization, so sterilizing filtration is the only practical way to sterilize the product - which is why it is called "THE method for aseptic fill-finish of biologics".

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務觀點
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Perspective

blocks.zh: 濾膜位置（Filter Placement）至關重要：USP 明確提到濾膜應盡量靠近灌裝線或保存槽。在 CDMO 環境中，這直接影響無菌保證水平（SAL）：
blocks.en: Filter placement is critical: USP explicitly states that the filter should be placed as close as practical to the filling line or holding vessel. In a CDMO setting, this directly affects the sterility assurance level (SAL):

blocks.zh: 濾膜距灌裝針越近，後過濾污染風險越低
blocks.en: The closer the filter is to the filling needle, the lower the risk of post-filtration contamination

blocks.zh: 但也意味著需要在 Grade A 環境中操作，增加 PUPSIT 等完整性測試的挑戰
blocks.en: But it also means the filter must be operated in a Grade A environment, which makes integrity testing such as PUPSIT more challenging

blocks.zh: 每個客戶產品的製程驗證需個別考量濾膜的最佳位置
blocks.en: The optimal filter position must be considered individually in the process validation of each client's product

blocks.zh: USP ⟨1229⟩ 系列章節架構
blocks.en: Structure of the USP ⟨1229⟩ Series

blocks.zh: 本章 ⟨1229.4⟩ 是 USP 滅菌總章 ⟨1229⟩ 的子章節之一。⟨1229⟩ 系列涵蓋所有滅菌方法，而 .4 專門聚焦液體除菌過濾。這是 USP 對除菌過濾最權威的指導文件，與 PDA TR26 互為補充。
blocks.en: This chapter, ⟨1229.4⟩, is one of the subchapters of the general sterilization chapter USP ⟨1229⟩. The ⟨1229⟩ series covers all sterilization methods, and .4 focuses specifically on sterilizing filtration of liquids. It is USP's most authoritative guidance on sterilizing filtration and complements PDA TR26.

blocks.zh: Sterilizing-Grade Filters — 除菌級濾膜定義
blocks.en: Sterilizing-Grade Filters - Definition

blocks.zh: B. diminuta 挑戰的黃金標準
blocks.en: B. diminuta: the Gold Standard Challenge

blocks.zh: Brevundimonas diminuta (ATCC 19146) 是全球公認的除菌級濾膜挑戰微生物：
blocks.en: Brevundimonas diminuta (ATCC 19146) is the globally recognized challenge organism for sterilizing-grade filters:

blocks.zh: 直徑約 0.3 µm — 是已知最小的可培養細菌之一
blocks.en: About 0.3 µm in diameter - one of the smallest known culturable bacteria

blocks.zh: 挑戰水平：10<sup>7</sup> CFU/cm² — 每平方公分一千萬個菌
blocks.en: Challenge level: 10<sup>7</sup> CFU/cm² - ten million organisms per square centimeter

blocks.zh: 通過標準：濾出液必須完全無菌（零 CFU 通過）
blocks.en: Acceptance criterion: the filtrate must be completely sterile (zero CFU passing through)

blocks.zh: 這個定義是除菌過濾驗證的基石，也是 PDA TR26 的核心參考。
blocks.en: This definition is the cornerstone of sterilizing filtration validation and a core reference of PDA TR26.

blocks.zh: 0.2 µm vs. 0.22 µm — 有什麼差別？
blocks.en: 0.2 µm vs. 0.22 µm - What Is the Difference?

blocks.zh: USP 使用 "about 0.2 µm" 的說法。實務上，不同供應商標示為 0.2 µm 或 0.22 µm，兩者功能上等效，都必須通過 ASTM F838 的 B. diminuta 挑戰測試。
blocks.en: USP uses the wording "about 0.2 µm". In practice, suppliers label their filters as either 0.2 µm or 0.22 µm; the two are functionally equivalent, and both must pass the B. diminuta challenge test of ASTM F838.

blocks.zh: 0.45 µm 的例外情境：USP 允許在特定條件下使用 0.45 µm 濾膜（如高黏度液體需要高壓差推動），但要求特別嚴格的前過濾生物負載控制。在 CDMO 實務中，除非客戶有特殊需求且提供完整的科學理由，否則一律使用 0.2 µm。
blocks.en: The 0.45 µm exception: USP allows 0.45 µm filters under specific conditions (for example, highly viscous liquids that need a high differential pressure to drive flow), but requires particularly strict control of prefiltration bioburden. In CDMO practice, 0.2 µm is always used unless the client has a special requirement and provides a complete scientific justification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 0.2 µm 除菌級濾膜就像機場安檢的標準 — 「除菌級」不僅僅是一個孔徑規格，而是一整套認證體系：濾膜要通過 ASTM F838 測試（類似機場安檢設備的型式認證），還需要每次使用時的完整性測試（類似每天開機前的安檢設備校準確認）。只有兩者都通過，才能宣稱「除菌級」。
blocks.en: A 0.2 µm sterilizing-grade filter is like airport security screening - "sterilizing-grade" is not just a pore size specification but a whole certification system: the filter must pass the ASTM F838 test (similar to type approval of the screening equipment), and it also needs an integrity test every time it is used (similar to the daily calibration check of the screening equipment before start-up). Only when both are passed can the filter be called "sterilizing-grade".

blocks.zh: Retention Mechanisms — 截留機制
blocks.en: Retention Mechanisms

blocks.zh: 為什麼這對驗證很重要？
blocks.en: Why Does This Matter for Validation?

blocks.zh: 當 USP 說「兩種機制都應在驗證中被考量」，這意味著你的細菌截留驗證（Bacterial Retention Validation）必須使用實際產品液（或盡可能接近的替代液），而非單純的水。因為：
blocks.en: When USP says "both mechanisms should be considered in validation", it means your bacterial retention validation must use the actual product fluid (or a surrogate as close as possible), not just water. This is because:

blocks.zh: 某些藥液中的界面活性劑（surfactant）會抑制吸附機制
blocks.en: Surfactants in some drug solutions can inhibit the adsorption mechanism

blocks.zh: 如果截留主要靠吸附，換了不同配方可能就失效
blocks.en: If retention relies mainly on adsorption, a change in formulation may cause it to fail

blocks.zh: 這是 PDA TR26 Section 6.0 細菌截留驗證章節的核心邏輯
blocks.en: This is the core logic of PDA TR26 Section 6.0 on bacterial retention validation

blocks.zh: Factors That Affect Retention — 影響截留的因素
blocks.en: Factors That Affect Retention

blocks.zh: 孔隙不是圓柱形
blocks.en: Pores Are Not Cylindrical

blocks.zh: 一個關鍵的觀念修正：濾膜的孔隙並非整齊的圓柱管道（除了 track-etched 膜），而是由不規則的多面體結構（pseudopolyhedral structures）組成的彎曲通道。這意味著：
blocks.en: A key correction to a common notion: filter pores are not neat cylindrical channels (except in track-etched membranes) but tortuous passages formed by irregular pseudopolyhedral structures. This means:

blocks.zh: 「0.2 µm」是名義孔徑（nominal pore size），不是精確的物理尺寸
blocks.en: "0.2 µm" is the nominal pore size, not an exact physical dimension

blocks.zh: 實際的截留能力取決於孔徑分佈的整體特性
blocks.en: Actual retention capability depends on the overall characteristics of the pore size distribution

blocks.zh: 這也是為什麼完整性測試（Integrity Test）比單純的孔徑量測更能預測微生物截留能力
blocks.en: This is also why an integrity test predicts microbial retention better than a simple pore size measurement

blocks.zh: 三種微生物穿透風險
blocks.en: Three Microbial Penetration Risks

blocks.zh: 變形穿透（Deformation）：在高壓差下，某些微生物可被擠壓變形通過孔隙 — 這是為什麼驗證要使用製程壓差條件
blocks.en: Deformation: under high differential pressure, some microorganisms can be squeezed and deformed through the pores - which is why validation must use process differential pressure conditions

blocks.zh: Mollicute（支原體類）穿透：缺乏細胞壁的支原體類微生物體積小且柔軟，可能穿過 0.2 µm 濾膜 — 這是為什麼生物製劑製程常使用 0.1 µm 前過濾
blocks.en: Mollicute penetration: mollicutes (mycoplasma-type organisms) lack a cell wall, are small and soft, and may pass through a 0.2 µm filter - which is why biologics processes often use 0.1 µm prefiltration

blocks.zh: 生長穿透（Grow-through）：微生物在濾膜上繁殖後，子代細胞可能穿過孔隙 — 這強調了控制過濾時間和前過濾生物負載的重要性
blocks.en: Grow-through: after microorganisms multiply on the filter membrane, daughter cells may pass through the pores - which underlines the importance of controlling filtration time and prefiltration bioburden

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，這三種風險都必須在風險評估中被記錄和處理。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, all three risks must be documented and addressed in the risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 界面活性劑的警告 — 0.05% 的教訓
blocks.en: Surfactant Warning - the Lesson of 0.05%

blocks.zh: USP 特別引用了一個關鍵數據：僅 0.05% 的界面活性劑就能抑制吸附機制。對 CDMO 而言，許多生物製劑配方中含有 Polysorbate 80（Tween 80）等界面活性劑作為穩定劑，濃度通常在 0.01%–0.1%。
blocks.en: USP cites a key data point: a surfactant at only 0.05% can inhibit the adsorption mechanism. For CDMOs, many biologics formulations contain surfactants such as Polysorbate 80 (Tween 80) as stabilizers, typically at 0.01%-0.1%.

blocks.zh: 這意味著你的細菌截留驗證必須使用含有界面活性劑的實際產品配方（或模擬液），而非單純的緩衝液。這也是 PDA TR26 要求使用 "process fluid" 進行驗證的原因。
blocks.en: This means your bacterial retention validation must use the actual product formulation containing the surfactant (or a simulated fluid), not just a buffer. This is also why PDA TR26 requires validation with the "process fluid".

blocks.zh: 水錘效應（Hydraulic Shock）的製程風險
blocks.en: Process Risks of Hydraulic Shock

blocks.zh: USP 特別警告避免水錘效應。在 CDMO 灌裝環境中，以下情況可能產生水錘：
blocks.en: USP specifically warns against hydraulic shock. In a CDMO filling environment, hydraulic shock can arise from:

blocks.zh: 泵浦突然啟停（特別是柱塞泵/蠕動泵）
blocks.en: Sudden pump starts and stops (especially piston pumps and peristaltic pumps)

blocks.zh: 閥門快速開關
blocks.en: Rapid opening and closing of valves

blocks.zh: 管線中的氣泡突然釋放
blocks.en: Sudden release of air bubbles in the line

blocks.zh: 水錘不僅降低截留效率，更可能直接損壞濾膜 — 這正是後過濾完整性測試（Post-use Integrity Test）存在的原因之一。
blocks.en: Hydraulic shock not only reduces retention efficiency but can also damage the filter membrane directly - which is one of the reasons the post-use integrity test exists.

blocks.zh: 濾膜結構與材質選擇
blocks.en: Filter Structure and Material Selection

blocks.zh: USP 列出的濾膜因素可以整理為一個選擇矩陣：
blocks.en: The filter factors listed by USP can be organized into a selection matrix:

blocks.zh: Filter Efficacy: Log Reduction Value — 過濾效能：對數降低值
blocks.en: Filter Efficacy: Log Reduction Value

blocks.zh: LRV 公式
blocks.en: LRV Formula

blocks.zh: 對除菌級濾膜而言，LRV 永遠報告為 "≥ log(challenge)" — 因為合格的除菌濾膜不允許任何挑戰菌通過，所以無法計算出精確的 LRV 值。
blocks.en: For sterilizing-grade filters, the LRV is always reported as "≥ log(challenge)" - because a qualified sterilizing filter allows no challenge organisms to pass, so an exact LRV value cannot be calculated.

blocks.zh: LRV 與無菌保證水平（SAL）的關係
blocks.en: Relationship Between LRV and Sterility Assurance Level (SAL)

blocks.zh: LRV ≥ 7 聽起來很高，但要注意這是每 cm² 膜面積的值。一個標準 10 吋濾芯（cartridge）的有效過濾面積約 0.7 m²（7,000 cm²），所以總挑戰水平為 107 × 7,000 = 7 × 1010 CFU。
blocks.en: An LRV ≥ 7 sounds high, but note that this is the value per cm² of membrane area. A standard 10-inch cartridge has an effective filtration area of about 0.7 m² (7,000 cm²), so the total challenge level is 107 × 7,000 = 7 × 1010 CFU.

blocks.zh: 在正常製程中，前過濾生物負載通常 < 10 CFU/100 mL — 這意味著實際操作中的安全裕度極大。這也說明了為什麼 USP 要求嚴格的前過濾生物負載控制。
blocks.en: In a normal process, prefiltration bioburden is typically < 10 CFU/100 mL - which means the actual safety margin in operation is very large. This also explains why USP requires strict control of prefiltration bioburden.

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節重點回顧
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾是生物製劑無菌充填的核心製程，屬於「物理去除」而非「破壞」微生物的方法
blocks.en: Sterilizing filtration is the core process of aseptic filling for biologics; it is a method of "physical removal" rather than "destruction" of microorganisms

blocks.zh: 除菌級濾膜定義：能截留 107 CFU/cm² B. diminuta（ATCC 19146），經 ASTM F838 測試，標準孔徑為 0.2 µm
blocks.en: Sterilizing-grade filter definition: a filter that retains 107 CFU/cm² of B. diminuta (ATCC 19146) when tested per ASTM F838; the standard pore size is 0.2 µm

blocks.zh: 兩大截留機制：篩分截留（sieve retention）可靠但受限於孔徑；吸附截留（adsorption）提供額外保護但受溶液組成影響
blocks.en: Two retention mechanisms: sieve retention is reliable but limited by pore size; adsorptive retention provides additional protection but depends on the solution composition

blocks.zh: 影響截留的四大因素：孔隙結構、微生物特性、溶液組成（界面活性劑 ≥ 0.05% 即可抑制吸附）、過濾條件（壓差/流速/溫度）
blocks.en: Four main factors affecting retention: pore structure, microbial characteristics, solution composition (a surfactant at ≥ 0.05% can inhibit adsorption), and filtration conditions (differential pressure/flow rate/temperature)

blocks.zh: LRV ≥ 7 是除菌級濾膜的基準，但實際無菌保證依賴整體系統：前過濾控制 + 濾膜驗證 + 完整性測試 + 無菌操作
blocks.en: LRV ≥ 7 is the benchmark for sterilizing-grade filters, but actual sterility assurance depends on the whole system: prefiltration control + filter validation + integrity testing + aseptic operation

blocks.zh: Cross-reference：PDA TR26 提供更詳細的驗證方法論，USP 本章提供法規性定義框架
blocks.en: Cross-reference: PDA TR26 provides more detailed validation methodology, while this USP chapter provides the regulatory definition framework
